home.title: Full_Stack Developer
home.description: Full-stack developer turning ideas into reliable, well-crafted web products. I work with React, TypeScript, Node.js and cloud tooling to ship clean code and great user experiences. Open to freelance projects and new opportunities, so get in touch.

header.title: Changelog of my experiences
header.description: Here is a timeline of my professional journey and key experiences throughout the years.

hospitality.intro: Before I wrote code, I spent years in hospitality, from the kitchen line to the front counter at fast food chains. It was fast, loud and unforgiving, and it taught me most of what I know about working with people.

cook.title: Cook
cook.summary: Prepared and assembled orders on the line, kept stations stocked and followed strict food safety routines while tickets kept coming in.

service.title: Service
service.summary: Took orders, handled payments and dealt with guests directly, including the ones who were already unhappy when they walked in.

barman.title: Barman
barman.summary: Prepared drinks, managed the bar area and coordinated with the kitchen to keep the service running smoothly.

lead.title: Shift lead
lead.summary: Coordinated the team during busy hours, trained new staff and made the quick calls that kept the shift running.
